## Homework 4

Global gender inequality (https://hdr.undp.org/data-center/documentation-and-downloads) and spatial data of the World (https://hub.arcgis.com/datasets/2b93b06dc0dc4e809d3c8db5cb96ba69_0/explore?location=-0.037581%2C0.000000%2C1.00)

## Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(janitor)
library(countrycode)
library(tmap)
```

### Read in data

```{r}
GII <- read_csv("HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv",
                       locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"),
                       na = " ", skip=0)

World <- st_read("World_Countries_(Generalized)_-7542350475356456390/World_Countries_Generalized.shp")
```

### Select required columns and insert new column of difference in gender inequality between 2010 and 2019

```{r}
GIIcols<- GII %>%
  clean_names()%>%
  select(iso3, country, gii_2019, gii_2010)%>%
  mutate(difference=gii_2019-gii_2010)%>%
  mutate(iso_code=countrycode(country, origin = 'country.name', destination = 'iso2c'))%>%
  mutate(iso_code2=countrycode(iso3, origin ='iso3c', destination = 'iso2c'))
```

### Join csv. to world shp.

```{r}
Join_GII <- World %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  left_join(., 
            GIIcols,
            # change to "aff_iso" = "iso_code"
            by = c("iso" = "iso_code"))
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")
# I chose to plot the difference in index 
Join_GII %>%
  qtm(.,fill = "difference")
```
